- [ ] Adds a new resource

- [ ] Updates a description or 🛂 rating
- [ ] Other

## Checklist

- [ ] Table rows follow the format in CONTRIBUTING.md, with every signal filled in.
- [ ] `npx awesome-lint README.md` passes (table pipes are aligned).
- [ ] Description is factual, not promotional.
- [ ] No em dashes (use a comma, colon, or new sentence).
- [ ] Korean terms use English first, Korean in parentheses on first mention (e.g., `identity verification (본인인증)`).
- [ ] I'm not affiliated with the resource, or I've disclosed the affiliation.
